description: A fleet-wide health overview for the External Secrets Operator, covering ExternalSecrets (including ClusterExternalSecrets), SecretStores (including ClusterSecretStores) and PushSecrets (including ClusterPushSecrets). Filterable by namespace and provider only - use the Resources dashboard to drill into a specific named resource. The dashboards were generated using [external-secrets-operator-mixin](https://github.com/adinhodovic/external-secrets-operator-mixin). Open issues and create feature requests in the repository.

panels.description: Total number of ExternalSecrets, SecretStores (incl. ClusterSecretStores) and PushSecrets (incl. ClusterPushSecrets) currently being monitored.

targets.expr:
count(
  count(
    externalsecret_status_condition{cluster="$cluster",
job=~"$job"
,
exported_namespace=~"$namespace"
}
    or
    clusterexternalsecret_status_condition{cluster="$cluster",
job=~"$job"

}
    or
    secretstore_status_condition{cluster="$cluster",
job=~"$job"
,
exported_namespace=~"$namespace"
}
    or
    clustersecretstore_status_condition{cluster="$cluster",
job=~"$job"

}
    or
    pushsecret_status_condition{cluster="$cluster",
job=~"$job"
,
exported_namespace=~"$namespace"
}
    or
    clusterpushsecret_status_condition{cluster="$cluster",
job=~"$job"

}
  ) by (exported_namespace, name)
)

panels.title: Total Resources
